subject: Contract renewal — terms update required before March 31
body: Hi, our annual software license renewal is scheduled for March 31. We have attached updated commercial terms and need your written confirmation by next week.

subject: Office closure notice: Holiday schedule for next week
body: Please note that the corporate offices will be closed on Monday for the scheduled public holiday. Security badge access will remain enabled.

subject: SECURITY ALERT: Unauthorized access detected from unknown IP
body: SOC automated alert: Suspicious credential stuffing attempts detected on account admin-gateway. Please review audit logs and escalate to the security on-call team.

subject: Exclusive invitation: 100x return crypto investment seminar
body: Do not miss out on the next 100x gem! Join our private VIP Telegram group to get early access to our private seed round.

subject: Department Happy Hour celebration next Thursday
body: Join us next Thursday at 5:30 PM at the rooftop lounge to celebrate completing our Q1 milestones! Drinks and snacks provided.

subject: Customer Escalation: Enterprise client SLA breach warning
body: Hi Support Team, Acme Corp reported that their API webhook integration has been failing for 4 hours. We are approaching our 99.9% SLA threshold and need immediate action.

subject: Invoice #INV-2026-889 Payment Receipt & Monthly Statement
body: Your monthly billing statement for August 2026 is now available in your account console. Total charge of $1,420.50 was successfully processed.

subject: CRITICAL: Stripe payment gateway webhook errors spiking (500s)
body: Over 200 customer credit card transactions failed in the last 15 minutes due to an unhandled exception in our webhook consumer. Escalate to the backend lead immediately.

subject: Board Meeting Deck Review — Please provide feedback by EOD
body: Team, please review slides 14-22 of the upcoming Q3 Board of Directors deck and reply with your department KPIs and comments before 6 PM today.

subject: Action Needed: Verify your hardware asset tag in inventory portal
body: As part of our annual IT audit, please confirm your laptop serial number and asset tag in the employee portal by Friday.
